lead.question: 闻名世界的大本钟如何得名？它为何能精准报时？又为何曾把时间报错？
lead.warmup: 伦敦泰晤士河畔的国会大厦钟楼上，悬挂着一口巨钟——大本钟。它的报时声通过英国广播公司传遍世界。鲜为人知的是，这座大钟的诞生源于1834年焚毁国会大厦的那场大火，它的名字来自主持修钟的本杰明·霍尔爵士；它的走时由格林尼治天文台每天两次校验，却也曾被一位油漆工挂在指针上的油漆桶拖慢。
goals: 熟练运用 take one's name from、be responsible for、be of + 抽象名词、have sth. done 等句型
复习第3类条件句与过去完成时被动
辨析 go wrong、fail to do、slow down、hang—hung—hung 等易混表达
lead.summary: 本课以大本钟为线索，串起一座建筑、一场大火与一个名字：1834年国会大厦被焚毁，才有重建时竖起的大钟；钟名取自负责铸钟的本杰明·霍尔爵士。钟体巨大却走时精准，靠格林尼治天文台每日两次校验；BBC 通过接在钟塔上的麦克风把钟声送向世界。大钟极少出错，唯一一次失误源于油漆工挂在指针上的一桶油漆。
lead.tips: 写第3类条件句时，if 从句用 had (been) done、主句用 would (never) have done，切勿与第2类条件句混用。

questions.q: Has Big Ben ever gone wrong?
questions.a: Yes, it has. Big Ben has rarely gone wrong, but once it failed to give the correct time, because a painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down.
questions.aZh: 出过一次。大本钟很少出差错，但有一次它报错了时间——一位在钟塔上干活的油漆工把一桶油漆挂在了一根指针上，把钟弄慢了。
questions.hint: 见 Big Ben has rarely gone wrong / it failed to give the correct time 及末句。

questions.q: Where does the name Big Ben come from, and what was Sir Benjamin Hall responsible for?
questions.zh: 名字从何而来？霍尔爵士负责什么？
questions.a: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall, who was responsible for the making of the clock when the new Houses of Parliament were being built.
questions.aZh: 它得名于本杰明·霍尔爵士；新国会大厦建造期间，他负责大钟的铸造。

questions.q: How do officials from Greenwich Observatory keep Big Ben accurate?
questions.zh: 天文台的官员如何让大本钟保持准确？
questions.a: They have the clock checked twice a day.
questions.aZh: 他们每天两次派人校正这座钟。
questions.hint: have + 宾语 + 过去分词的使役用法。

questions.q: Why can listeners hear Big Ben actually striking on the B.B.C.?
questions.zh: 为什么听众能从广播里听到大钟正在打点？
questions.a: Because microphones are connected to the clock tower.
questions.aZh: 因为钟塔上接了麦克风。

questions.q: If the Houses of Parliament had not been burned down in 1834, what would have happened to the great clock? What grammar is used here?
questions.zh: 如果国会大厦没有在1834年被焚毁，这座大钟会怎样？用了什么语法？
questions.a: It would never have been erected. The sentence uses a Type 3 conditional to imagine an unreal past: in fact the Houses were burned down, and so the clock was erected.
questions.aZh: 这座大钟永远也不会建造。这是第3类条件句，表示与过去事实相反的假设。

exercises.q: 汉译英：格林尼治天文台的官员们每天两次派人校正这座钟。
exercises.a: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked twice a day.

exercises.q: 用第3类条件句改写：The Houses of Parliament were burned down in 1834, so the great clock was erected.
exercises.a: If the Houses of Parliament had not been burned down in 1834, the great clock would never have been erected.

exercises.q: 用 take one's name from 翻译：大本钟得名于本杰明·霍尔爵士。
exercises.a: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall.

exercises.q: 就划线部分提问：Sir Benjamin Hall was responsible for the making of the clock.
exercises.a: Who was responsible for the making of the clock?

exercises.q: 用所给动词的适当形式填空：A painter who ________ (work) on the tower hung a pot of paint on one of the hands.
用 be of + 抽象名词改写：The clock is not only very large, but extremely accurate as well.
exercises.a: The clock is not only of immense size, but is extremely accurate as well.

exercises.q: 汉译英：大本钟很少出差错。然而有一次，它却把时间报错了——一位油漆工把一桶油漆挂在了一根指针上，把钟弄慢了！
exercises.a: Big Ben has rarely gone wrong. Once, however, it failed to give the correct time — a painter hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down!

options: Sir Benjamin Hall
Sir Winston Churchill
An official from Greenwich Observatory
The painter who worked on the tower

quiz.q: 1834年国会大厦被焚毁与大钟的建造之间是什么关系？
options: If the Houses of Parliament had not been burned down in 1834, the great clock would never have been erected
The great clock was erected long before the fire of 1834
The fire was caused by the great clock
The great clock was burned down together with the Houses

quiz.q: 人们为什么能从广播里听到大钟打点？
options: Microphones are connected to the clock tower
The clock is of immense size
Officials check it twice a day
Big Ben has rarely gone wrong

quiz.q: 格林尼治天文台的官员如何保证大钟走时准确？
options: They have the clock checked twice a day
They check the clock once a week
They replaced the old clock with a new one
They slowed the clock down on purpose

quiz.q: 大本钟唯一一次报错时间的原因是什么？
options: A painter hung a pot of paint on one of the hands
The clock was never an accurate instrument
The microphones went wrong that day
The officials failed to check it twice a day

quiz.q: 下列哪一句中 hung 表示“悬挂”？
options: A painter hung a pot of paint on one of the hands
The murderer was hanged last week
She hanged herself in her room
He was hanged for murder
